results.segment: Clare Davies-McLean Flat 47 Murray Cliffs South Brendashire E8 8LF
We are writing to let you know that external redecoration and gutter replacement will begin at your building on 17 May 2026. Scaffolding will be erected the week before.
You do not need to do anything for the works to go ahead. Our contractor, Singh Maintenance, will knock before working near your windows.

obligations.ask: Tell us if you have a medical condition affecting noise or dust

results.segment: If you have a medical condition that means noise or dust would affect you, please tell us by 30 May 2026 so we can plan around it.
Work is expected to take 6 weeks, weather permitting.
Mrs Lesley Charlton Neighbourhood Officer Harrowdene Housing Association
